create_validatable_config: create a dataclass that implements the Validatable protocol with a validate method returning ValidationResult
validate_object_with_standardvalidator: validate a configuration dataclass using StandardObjectValidator to check all fields and sub-objects recursively
add_validation_error: add an error message to a ValidationResult when a field fails validation checks
handle_validation_error: handle a ValidationError exception and inspect its result attribute for error details and sub-results
build_pathname_for_nested_errors: build a dot-separated pathname string from a list of field path segments for nested validation errors
